description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerHelper class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies permission retrieval logic based on user roles and employee associations, utilizing mock objects and data providers for various test scenarios.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserRoleManagerHelper, testing various permission retrieval and self-identification methods using mock objects and data providers.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithoutAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee without an associated Employee entity.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee with an assigned Employee entity.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForSelfPermission
methods.description: Verifies permission retrieval when querying permissions for self (matching employee number).

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForNotSelfPermission
methods.description: Verifies permission retrieval for another employee (not self).

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Tests obtaining a collection of data group permissions for an employee and converting it to array form.

methods.name: testIsSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Uses data provider to test whether the helper correctly identifies if the current user is the employee in question.
